note: Factual stats only, each from an official athletics site. No projections.

stats.name: BYU
stats.label: Receiving yards by Kyler Kasper
stats.line: Kyler Kasper caught six passes for 129 yards and a touchdown, the Cougars' top receiving total, in BYU's 39-31 double-overtime loss at UCF. BYU is 6-1 overall and 3-1 in Big 12 play.

stats.name: Utah
stats.label: Rushing yards by Devon Dampier
stats.line: Devon Dampier ran for a season-high 150 yards and two touchdowns and completed 18 of 26 passes for 204 yards in No. 10 Utah's 21-13 win over No. 14 Houston. His 1,183 rushing yards in two seasons at Utah trail only Travis Wilson (1,225, 2012-15) among quarterbacks in recorded program history.
stats.game: No. 10 Utah 21, No. 14 Houston 13 — Sat Oct 24, Salt Lake City

stats.name: Utah State
stats.label: Catches by Anthony Garcia, a career high
stats.line: Graduate receiver Anthony Garcia posted a career-high eight receptions for 87 yards and also threw his first pass attempt of the season, a 6-yard touchdown to Kaina Watson on a trick play, in Utah State's 20-17 loss at Texas State.
stats.game: Texas State 20, Utah State 17 — Sat Oct 24, San Marcos

stats.name: Weber State
stats.label: Receiving yards by Noah Kjar
stats.line: Noah Kjar led Weber State with eight receptions for 124 yards, including a 68-yard reception early in the game, in the 38-33 loss at No. 3 Montana State. Nate Dahle threw for 240 yards and two touchdowns without an interception.
stats.game: No. 3 Montana State 38, No. 22 Weber State 33 — Sat Oct 24, Bozeman

stats.name: Southern Utah
stats.label: Total yards by Will Burns
stats.line: Will Burns finished with 392 yards of total offense, 205 passing and 187 rushing, and threw a 57-yard touchdown pass to Mark Bails on fourth-and-10 with 42 seconds left to tie it at 28 in the 31-28 loss at Idaho. His rushing total extended Southern Utah's run of having a 100-yard rusher in every game dating back to homecoming in 2025.
stats.game: Idaho 31, Southern Utah 28 — Sat Oct 24, Moscow

stats.name: Utah Tech
stats.label: Yards per punt by Ryan Marks
stats.line: Ryan Marks is averaging 46.6 yards on 32 punts through eight games, with ten punts of 50 yards or more and a long of 70 against Northern Arizona.
stats.game: Season stats through Oct 24 — Utah Tech 43, Cal Poly 26
